mapper.insert: insert man_day (project_id, member_id, member_name, actual_man_day, week_start_date, week_end_date, create_man_id, create_man) values (#{projectId}, #{memberId}, #{memberName}, #{actualManDay}, #{weekStartDate}, #{weekEndDate}, #{createManId}, #{createMan})
mapper.select: select * from man_day where id = #{id} and is_deleted = false
select * from man_day where project_id = #{projectId} and is_deleted = false order by week_start_date desc
select * from man_day where week_start_date = #{startDate} and is_deleted = false
select sum(actual_man_day) from man_day where project_id = #{projectId} and is_deleted = false
